card.name: Linking words before listed examples
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas or prepositions that come right before a list of named places or items, such as 'including', a comma after the first list item, or 'in' before a place name. Mostly general web prose, not drug labels.

modes.label: Lead-in to a list
modes.description: The word 'including' or a comma inside a list of place names.
modes.example: Winchmore Hill was one of a circle of small settlements in north London<< including>> Palmers Green, Colney Hatch,

modes.description: A preposition or space just before a place name.
modes.example: Although Universal welcomed tourists at its vast studio ranch<< in>> the San Fernando Valley, the other studios

modes.label: Inside a list of sources
modes.description: A word partway through a list of causes or items.
modes.example: In the home CO can be formed, for example, by open flames, space heaters, water heaters, blocked chimneys or<< running>> a car inside a garage.
